head: b8de89c6ade6a2898860011691050bf62abddedc
claim: The built public @byokit/speak lets an app connect its selected provider, choose and persist one voice, and receive speech audio; missing selection and provider errors never switch provider or voice.

steps.start: A consumer app has no saved provider or voice choice; a task-owned loopback fake speech provider is running.
steps: Call speak with no saved choice and observe the explicit choose-provider-and-voice refusal.
Connect the OpenAI-compatible adapter using a synthetic key, task-owned loopback base URL and model.
List the fake provider's voices and explicitly select and persist voice-1.
Speak Hi Umer; verify the request names voice-1 and the consumer receives the fake MP3 bytes.
Make the fake speech endpoint return HTTP 503 and observe the provider error without fallback.
steps.result: The built public package connected to the selected provider, listed and persisted voice-1, returned fake audio bytes, refused missing selection and surfaced HTTP 503 without switching voices or providers.

verdicts.seen: The capture is one log line with seven records, all read. It shows 'connected', 'listed 1 voice', 'saved explicit choice', 'returned 3 audio bytes', and 'missing selection refused', and 'HTTP 503 surfaced' shows the provider error was reported rather than rerouted. Nothing shows a provider or voice switch, so it matches the outcome. It does not show persistence directly, so some doubt remains.
